# Brooch of Shielding (`magic-items:brooch-of-shielding`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.
